title: referencing
description: Result schema for referencing the predication-cell-set. The projection-kind selects which morphism from $\Phi = E \times \Pi \times E$ produces the result: subject-projection ($\pi_E^{(1)}: \Phi \to E$), predicate-projection ($\pi_\Pi: \Phi \to \Pi$), object-projection ($\pi_E^{(2)}: \Phi \to E$), coordinate-swap ($\sigma: \Phi \to \Phi$ on the two E-coordinates), or identity (returns the cells unchanged).

result.description: The projected output. Type depends on projection-kind: entity-slugs for subject/object projections; predicate-slugs for predicate-projection; predication-cells for coordinate-swap and identity.

source-cardinality.description: The number of cells from the source predication-cell-set that the projection ranged over.

result-cardinality.description: The number of distinct results yielded by the projection.

deduplicated.description: Whether the result has had duplicate values collapsed (the morphism's set-image rather than multiset-image).
